# Resultar

> Typed, composable error handling for TypeScript: start with synchronous `Result` values,
> use lazy `ResultTask` for all asynchronous workflows (executing via `task.runResult()` ->
> native `Promise<Result<T, E>>`), and optionally use the `@deprecated` `resultar/async` compatibility
> subpath for legacy eager `ResultAsync` boundaries. Add typed services, scopes, clocks,
> retry, and fibers as needed. Tagged errors and compiler-backed diagnostics. Node.js 24+, ESM-only.

- [Resultar documentation and playground](https://inaiat.github.io/resultar/)

## Installed version first

Install `resultar-check` as a development dependency for the offline index at
`node_modules/resultar-check/dist/llms.txt` and the guide at `node_modules/resultar-check/dist/agent/SKILL.md`.
Compare `node_modules/resultar-check/dist/agent/versions.json` with your installed runtime and companion packages.
The links below follow development on `main`; they are not a substitute for versioned local types.

## Start here

- [Promise boundaries and application contracts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/DOCUMENTATION.md#promise-boundaries-and-application-contracts): raw driver Promise -> tryPromise; existing typed Async -> fromResultAsync; new application methods return Task.

- [Agent skill (`SKILL.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/SKILL.md): execution contracts and progressive routing for coding agents.
- [API semantics (`references/api.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/references/api.md): feature map and semantic constraints for `Result`, `ResultTask`, opt-in `resultar/async` (`ResultAsync`), `createTaggedError`, `taggedEnum`, `redact`, `Match`, `Cause`, `Fiber`, `Semaphore`, `Deferred`, `Queue`, `Ref`, `TaskLocal`, `Tracer`, `Retry`, `Clock`, `Scheduler`, `pipe`/`flow`, and subpath exports (`resultar/result`, `resultar/task`, `resultar/match`, `resultar/tagged`, `resultar/retry`, `resultar/function`, `resultar/async`).
- [Anti-patterns & `resultar-check` guide (`references/anti-patterns.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/references/anti-patterns.md): configuration, `--fix`, `migrate-v5`, multi-editor setup, repair guidance, and links to all 43 native diagnostics.
- [Production workflow patterns (`references/patterns.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/references/patterns.md): rich domain errors, `ResultTask.memoize`, `onExit`, background worker loops with `runFork`, uncooperative Promise timeouts with `interruption: 'detach'`, bounded concurrency, and `VirtualClock` testing.
- [Services, DI, HTTP adapters & outbound requests (`references/services.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/references/services.md): `serviceTag`, `resultar-di`, `resultar-hono`, `resultar-fastify`, `resultar-nestjs`, and `resultar-request` (`zod` and `typebox`).
- [Boundary integrations (`references/integrations.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/references/integrations.md): HTTP route status mapping, database session ownership, and event consumer bridges.
- [Code review checklist (`references/review-checklist.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/references/review-checklist.md): behavior and verification checklist.
- [Coming from Effect](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/coming-from-effect.md): side-by-side concept and API map vs Effect core, plus deliberate omissions.
- [Gradual adoption](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/gradual-adoption.md): start with Result, use ResultTask for new async work, bridge existing eager APIs explicitly, and add Clock, retry, and fibers when needed.
- [Core package README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/resultar/README.md): model, ResultTask, services, scopes, decision guide.
- [Full guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/DOCUMENTATION.md): complete API map and recipes.

`Result<T, E>` models a success value and expected errors. `ResultTask<T, E, R>` additionally
tracks unresolved requirements in `R`. These models coexist: adopting tasks does not require
rewriting existing Result helpers, eager adapters, or the whole application. Preserve existing
execution contracts when bridging between them.

`task.runResult()` (and `ResultTask.runResult(task)`) executes a lazy `ResultTask` and returns a
native `Promise<Result<T, E | ScopeError<R>>>`. `@deprecated` eager `ResultAsync` and `StrictResultAsync`
live in the `"resultar/async"` compatibility subpath (with `ResultAsync.gen` / `ResultAsync.fn`,
`okAsync`, `errAsync`, `unitAsync`, `fromPromise`, `fromSafePromise`, `tryResultAsync`, `safeTry`,
`DisposableResultAsync`, standalone `asyncMap` / `asyncAndThen`, and v4 eager compatibility helpers).
Root `"resultar"` exports only `Result`, `ResultTask`, and shared primitives with zero `ResultAsync` imports.
Task is non-thenable: use explicit `runResult`, `runExit`, `runPromise`, or `runFork` boundaries
even when `R = never`. Task `map` is synchronous; compose Promise steps with `andThen` and
`tryPromise`. `ResultTask.fromResultAsync(factory)` structurally accepts any `PromiseLike<Result<T, E>>`
(including native `Promise<Result<T, E>>` or `ResultAsync` from `"resultar/async"`).
Core `Result.gen` and `Result.fn` are synchronous-only with plain return values.

## Packages

- [Public API inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/api-inventory.md): generated from built declarations, including types and public members.
- [Executable recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/recipes.md): compiled and behavior-tested contracts.

- [resultar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/resultar/README.md): core `Result`, lazy `ResultTask`, `Deferred`, `Queue`, `Ref`, `TaskLocal`, `Tracer`, subpath exports, and opt-in `resultar/async` compatibility.
- [resultar-app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/app/README.md): unified entry point re-exporting `resultar`, `resultar-di`, and `resultar-config`.
- [resultar-config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/config/README.md): lazy, typed Node environment configuration with TypeBox schemas, redaction, and DI startup ordering.
- [resultar-di](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/di/README.md): services, typed composition, lifetimes, overrides, named registration and framework adapter APIs.
- [resultar-hono](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/hono/README.md): Hono bindings, one scope per response, CloseError.
- [resultar-fastify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/fastify/README.md): native plugins, application/request services, cancellation and cleanup.
- [resultar-nestjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/nestjs/README.md): native NestJS modules, `@Services()` decorator, application/request services, cancellation and cleanup.
- [resultar-request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/request/README.md) with [resultar-request-typebox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/request-typebox/README.md) (TypeBox) and [resultar-request-zod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/request-zod/README.md) (Zod) adapters (all returning `ResultTask`).
- [resultar-check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/check/README.md): 43 native TypeScript-Go diagnostics, `--fix`, `migrate-v5`, LSP server, and Zed/VS Code/Cursor setup.

- [Hono app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/hono/README.md): matching service classes, AppHono inferred in main.ts and native routes.
- [request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/request/README.md), [check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/check/README.md).
- [Fastify app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/fastify/README.md): class services with requires, function-based health, TypeBox routes and request.services inferred in main.ts.
- [NestJS app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/nestjs/README.md): class services with requires, function-based health, native controllers with `@Services()` and `AppRequestServices` inferred in main.ts.

## Design records (history, not usage truth)

- [RFC 0001](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/rfcs/rfc-0001-result-task-core.md): ResultTask architecture. Design history; see current package README and the next-major adoption guide for implemented APIs.
- [RFC 0002](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/rfcs/rfc-0002-di-lifetimes-scopes.md): DI lifetimes and request scopes (implemented).
- [RFC 0003](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/rfcs/rfc-0003-phase-3-remainder-and-validation.md): remaining work tracker.

## Promise defect boundaries

`ResultTask.fromPromise(signal => operation(signal))` defers a raw Promise factory
until each run and returns `ResultTask<A, never, never>`. Throws and rejections
become runtime defects; `runResult()` rejects for these failures. Use
`tryPromise({ try, catch })` for expected errors and `fromResultAsync` for existing
Result-producing operations. Unlike eager `ResultAsync.fromPromise`, this factory
accepts no error mapper or already-started Promise.

Cancellation waits for settlement. Register resource ownership directly with
`acquireRelease` before composing transformations so late acquisitions are released.
The checker recognizes async factories as explicit defect boundaries for
`no-unsafe-await`; `catchCause` remains meaningful even when `E = never`.

## Freshness rule

Package READMEs override `DOCUMENTATION.md`; both override the
skill; RFCs are design history. The installed `node_modules` types always win over any document.

- [v5 migration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/migrations/v5.md): unified `Result` + `ResultTask` async model, native `Promise<Result>` from `runResult()`, opt-in `resultar/async` subpath, Task-native `resultar-request*`, and `resultar-check migrate-v5`.
- [v4 migration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/migrations/v4.md): historical v4 Task-first transition notes.
